Add the environment-signals blueprint: a plan for giving minds sleep and connectivity awareness (heartbeat-gap sleep tracker, demand-driven internet/SSH connectivity facets) so laptop-side conditions stop being convicted as workspace death -- gating the unattended restart dispatch, resetting sleep-straddling STUCK failure runs, re-baselining the discovery watchdog at wake, and adding offline / SSH-blocked recovery card states. Now carries a record of the decisions taken while implementing it (SSH quorum endpoints, the copy for both states, where the app-level indicator lives, and the tuning constants), and a record of what two live staging-vs-production log comparisons showed the built thing actually doing -- one over a pair of deliberate network outages, one over an unattended overnight and a commute -- so the plan documents what was built and how it behaved rather than what was proposed.
